options.text: An isolated process running on the host OS

questions.explanation: Containers share the host kernel but provide isolated user space, unlike full virtual machines.

questions.prompt: Which Docker command builds an image from a Dockerfile?
questions.explanation: docker build reads the Dockerfile and constructs the image layer by layer.

questions.prompt: Which statement about Dockerfile layers is true?

options.text: Each RUN instruction creates a new layer that persists in the image
COPY commands do not create layers
The order of commands does not affect image size
All layers are stored in the host filesystem

questions.explanation: Every Dockerfile instruction creates a separate layer; the order influences cache and final size.
